sections.title: Showcase builds
sections.blurb: Recognisable structures that need distinctive steps.

sections.title: Complex builds
sections.blurb: Harder structures, some failing, with the variants tried to build them.

sections.title: Break tests (failures on purpose)
sections.blurb: Each pushes one failure mechanism, some with a matched control.

sections.title: Basics
sections.blurb: Simple builds used to check the controller and the breakage model.

dog.title: Dog
dog.description: Ten bricks: four legs, a wide body bridging them, a neck, head and tail.
dog.tests: wide bricks bridging legs; ten-brick figure

bridge.title: Arch bridge
bridge.description: A corbel arch: each pier steps one stud inward, then a 2x10 deck closes the arch by landing on both piers. Two parapets finish the deck.
bridge.tests: a deck landing on two piers (corbel arch)

house.title: House
house.description: A facade with a doorway. Two walls stand two courses high, a 2x10 lintel spans the door and lands on both walls, and a stepped gable roof and a chimney finish it.
house.tests: a lintel over a doorway; stepped roof
house.mechanism: B: release load on an 8-stud wall joint
house.note: At the default 1 s gripper release, the first wall joint (8 studs) breaks during a release with no visible motion. With a 2 s release the house completes; the picture and video are that run.

log_cabin.title: Log cabin
log_cabin.description: Courses alternate direction, and every brick above the first interlocks two corners below. It is planned on one corner and lands on both.

locomotive.title: Steam locomotive
locomotive.description: Three wheels, a 2x10 chassis that rests on all three, a cab with an overhanging roof, a boiler and a chimney.
locomotive.tests: a chassis resting on three wheels

lighthouse.title: Lighthouse
lighthouse.description: A 4x6 rock, a tower striped red and white, a yellow lamp and a red cap: seven layers, the tallest showcase build.
lighthouse.tests: a seven-layer tower on a wide base

castle_gate.title: Castle gate
castle_gate.description: Two towers flank the gate, a 2x10 lintel spans it and lands on both towers, and three battlements line the top.
castle_gate.tests: a lintel over a gate; battlements

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: A three-high 2x2 trunk under a crown of 2x6, 4x2 and 2x2 bricks.
tree.tests: a crown on a 2x2 trunk (4-stud joints)
tree.mechanism: B: the trunk's 4-stud base joint breaks on the releases, transiently, then for good

table.title: Table
table.description: Four 2x2 legs two bricks high under two 2x6 tops.
table.tests: four legs, then tops spanning them
table.mechanism: C: legs 2 studs apart leave no room for the RG2 fingers to let go

table_grip.title: Table, grip-aware
table_grip.description: The table's ten bricks, with each grip chosen for room. The legs are gripped across the axis where they are 4 studs apart, and the 2x8 tops are gripped end to end, so no finger enters a 2-stud gap.
table_grip.tests: the table with grips chosen for room

trestle_table.title: Trestle table
trestle_table.description: Two slab legs of 2x4 bricks gripped end to end under a 4x6 top.
trestle_table.tests: slab legs gripped end to end

mixed_tower.title: Mixed tower
mixed_tower.description: Eight bricks of three sizes stacked with offsets.
mixed_tower.mechanism: D: a brick stops on the studs and does not seat

cross_tower.title: Cross-bonded tower
cross_tower.mechanism: E: the second joint breaks after four breakage-solver non-convergences

spiral_tower.title: Spiral tower
spiral_tower.description: Ten 2x4 bricks, each a quarter turn from the one below.
spiral_tower.mechanism: E: the second joint breaks after four breakage-solver non-convergences

l_corner.title: L corner
l_corner.description: Two posts joined by a corner brick.
l_corner.tests: a corner brick joining two posts
l_corner.mechanism: A: press load through a 4-stud joint

tower.title: Offset tower
tower.description: Six 2x4 bricks alternating direction, each shifted by a stud.
tower.mechanism: B: release load on a 4-stud joint

cantilever.title: Cantilever
cantilever.description: A 2x6 rests by one end on a 2x2 column, with a 2x2 pressed onto its free tip.
cantilever.tests: a press on a cantilever tip

cantilever_tip2.title: Cantilever, two bricks at the tip
cantilever_tip2.description: Two 2x2 bricks pressed onto the free tip of the cantilever.
cantilever_tip2.tests: two bricks at a cantilever tip
cantilever_tip2.mechanism: A: the press pries the column's base joint off before the brick seats

cantilever_root2.title: Cantilever, two bricks over the support (control)
cantilever_root2.description: The same two bricks pressed over the support instead of the tip.
cantilever_root2.tests: the same bricks over the support (control)

lean_ladder.title: Leaning ladder
lean_ladder.description: Eight 4x2 bricks, each shifted one stud: the lean grows with every layer.
lean_ladder.tests: a lean that grows every layer
lean_ladder.mechanism: B: growing overturning moment on the low joints

tower_2x2.title: 2x2 tower
tower_2x2.description: Ten 2x2 bricks: every joint has only 4 studs.
tower_2x2.mechanism: B: the base joint breaks transiently on each release, then for good

lean_6.title: Lean 6
lean_6.description: Six 2x4 bricks, each shifted 2 studs (4-stud joints).
lean_6.mechanism: B: release load on a 4-stud joint

zigzag_6.title: Zigzag 6
zigzag_6.description: Six 2x4 bricks shifted +2 and -2 studs in turn.
zigzag_6.mechanism: A: press load through a 4-stud joint

column_10.title: Column of ten
column_10.description: Ten aligned 2x4 bricks: the load on the base grows with height.
column_10.tests: load on the base growing with height
column_10.mechanism: B: release load accumulated over ten layers

column_turned.title: Column, turned 90 degrees
column_turned.description: The 4-brick column with every brick laid along x: the same 8-stud joints, gripped with the wrist turned 90 degrees. It is a control for the house wall.
column_turned.tests: the column with bricks turned 90 degrees

column.title: Column
column.description: Four aligned 2x4 bricks (8-stud joints). It is also the press-force sweep: it holds at 1 and 2 N and loses its base joint at 3 and 5 N.
